title: רב יהודה מדפתא

paragraphs: The entry says Rav Yehudah of Difti stood before Ravina and was told to see whether the excrement had formed a crust. [In Berakhot 25a, Ravina reports that he stood before Rav Yehudah of Difti and received the instruction. Another version asks whether the surface had cracked.]
